❯ Without using any tools, write about 600 words of plain prose on the history of canals.           

⏺ Canals are among the oldest large-scale engineering works people have built, and their history
  tracks the growth of agriculture, trade, empire and industry. The earliest were irrigation
  channels in Mesopotamia, dug perhaps as early as 6000 BCE to carry water from the Tigris and
  Euphrates to fields that would otherwise have been desert. These ditches made surplus harvests
